stories.text: St Lawrence's dates from the 13th century; it was restored in 1789 and repaired in 1869, and Reuben Bosworth made its tower clock in 1848 for £70. Among its memorials is one to John St Andrew and his wife, of 1625. It is listed Grade I.

21328.sum: St. Lawrence's Church, Gotham is a Grade I listed parish church in the Church of England in Gotham, Nottinghamshire. It is part of an informal grouping of five churches that are known collectively as "The 453 Churches" as they straddle the A453.
